items.title: "Pete" Ferdinand Valentine Interview, 1960-06-24
items.q: Well, I didn't get to see him. I didn't get to see him on the parade, Manuel.

ctx.x: What about people like Freddy Keppert and Manuel Perez and Buddy Bolden and Joe Alton? Did you hear those guys?
Well, I didn't get to see him. I didn't get to see him on the parade, Manuel.
You didn't see him, Manuel Perez? Yeah, Manuel.
